messages:
ana_marketing: Quick design request for the launch next Thurs — tight but doable. Need a mini asset kit focused on inference economics + webinar promo.
ana_marketing: Deliverables: hero GIF (looping, 1600x900), one benchmark sparkline image (1200x400), a compact slide template (16:9) with speaker notes callouts, 3 ad banners (600x200, 1200x628, 300x250), and one accessibility-checked registration page hero (1200x600). Also include a lightweight PNG + SVG for each graphic.
ana_marketing: Tone: technical but approachable. Visual cues: token-pulse, small cache icon, and a cost-per-token sparkline. Two colorways: default blue and neutral mono. Keep exports <200kb where possible.
cam_design: Sounds good. Any copy we should lock now? Also do we need localized versions for APAC?
ana_marketing: Core copy below. Localization: only JA/EN for now. Tessa can confirm copy variants.
tessa_research: I'll provide translated headlines by Mon EOD. Also attaching a rapid benchmark blurb for the sparkline: "Simulated workload: conversational routing. Median latency 65ms. Unit cost reduced by 2.6x with caching + batching." - you may want legal on comparative language.
luke_growth: For the banners, please include a variant that has an explicit paid CTA ("Register now") and an organic CTA ("Learn more"). Use the paid CTA on 600x200 and 300x250.
sanjay_prod: Tech note for the hero GIF: keep animation at 10fps and avoid heavy gradients for mobile decoding. If you need svg keyframes I can provide an inline-friendly loader component.
morgan_legal: Flagging the comparative metric. Send me the exact phrasing and source. I can clear or suggest language that's safe for public copy.
cam_design: Plan: draft comps tonight. Will mock hero static + GIF, sparkline comp, and slide template by Mon 10:00 PT. Will upload layered source files in Figma and provide export presets.
ana_marketing: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz999/inference-launch-mini-kit (marketing team has edit). Please name frames with asset id and language code.
ana_marketing: Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for CTA buttons, alt text for all images, and logical tab order on the registration hero.
cam_design: Noted. Will create an "alt-copy" field in the figma notes for each asset and include suggested alt text.
tessa_research: Also request: include a tiny one-slide "benchmark methodology" visual (single column) so we can post it as a supporting tweet thread.
luke_growth: Could we also get a 1:1 cropped hero for in-app promos? 1080x1080, same visual system.
cam_design: Adding 1080x1080 crop to scope.
sanjay_prod: If you want to show dynamic routing in the hero, use simplified icons only. Don't show internal queue names in public-facing assets. Use generic labels like "premium" and "standard".
morgan_legal: Approving that approach. Send me final hero headline.
nana_marketing: Headline candidates: 
- "Infer at cloud-scale with predictable economics"
- "Lower inference costs without sacrificing latency"
- "Better serving, lower unit costs: the inference playbook"
nana_marketing: Use option 1 for paid, option 2 for organic.
cam_design: Will mock both. Anything else?
design-bot: Uploaded: figma://inference-launch/1765600123 (preview: https://figma-preview.example/1765600123). Export presets: SVG, PNG@2x, GIF loop.
cam_design: I'll post first-pass thumbnails by Mon 10:00 PT and tag this thread. Priority order: 1) hero GIF + static, 2) benchmark sparkline + methodology slide, 3) banners + 1:1 crop, 4) slide template + speaker notes, 5) registration hero accessibility pass.
nana_marketing: Thanks team. Morgan  ping you directly when hero copy is uploaded.
morgan_legal: Roger. If the methodology slide cites internal numbers, mark it "illustrative" and include the small footer: "Data for illustration only."
nana_marketing: Will do. End.
